title: Result view — facility-capability
description: What a FACILITY has evidenced, calculated by checklist-api and nowhere else. R4 B6. ⚠️ FOUR SEPARATE PAYLOADS, and no payload may combine views. A payload holding a facility's capability beside another facility's is one query-string change from a league table — and DEC-005 is absolute: rank inquiry, never rank a hospital.
$comment: NO SORT PARAMETER, and no comparative field, anywhere in this payload. check-repo.sh refuses one across every contract. A sort parameter on a comparative field IS the league table; it does not need a UI to become one.
